title: Rockets' Tari Eason Violates Magic's Emanuel Terry On The First Play Against the Magic [Watch]
htmlContent:
The Houston Rockets are taking on the Orlando Magic in NBA Summer League, and in the game's first play, Tari Eason violated forward Emanuel Terry. Eason drives down the lane and dunks on Terry.

Tari Eason was a basketball standout at LSU. He led the Tigers in multiple stats in spite of not being a starter, including points per game, blocks and goal percentage on the pitch. He also finished second on the team in rebounds, steals, free throw percentage and three-point percentage.

Eason averaged 17 points, 6.6 rebounds, two steals, and a block on 52% fielding, 80% of the free-throw line, and 36% of the three-point range.

Houston Rockets drafted Eason at No. 17 in last months draft.
